highlights: 2% cashback on dining, retail, department stores, transport, and local purchases, and 1% cashback on foreign currency spending and all other expenses. A minimum spend of S$1,000 is required for cashback on dining, retail, transport, and local purchases. Additionally, a minimum spend of S$500 is required for department stores, and you can earn an additional 1% cashback if you spend more than S$2,500 in the same statement month. All qualifying cashbacks have no cap.
pros: Unlimited 2% cashback on dining, movies & digital entertainment, taxi, ride-hailing, automobile, and luxury goods.
pros: Unlimited 1% on all other eligible spend with no minimum spend.
pros: Enjoy 50% off green fees at 25 golf courses.
pros: Access to over 1,000 LoungeKey airport lounges globally.
pros: Can be used for bus and train rides with SimplyGo.
pros: No annual fees for life + up to 4 supplementary cards with no annual fees.
cons: Only Singapore citizens and Permanent Residents may apply.
cons: Minimum annual income requirement: S$30,000.
cons: Minimum spend of S$1,000 required for 2% cashback earn rate.
cons: Minimum spend of S$500 required for 1% cashback earn rate.

extra.tag: Best for frequent spending on common spend categories
extra.description: Boasting the highest unlimited cashback in Singapore, the CIMB World Mastercard is a formidable card to own if you spend frequently on the following categories: dining, online food delivery, movies, digital entertainment, taxi rides, ride-hailing, automobile, and luxury goods
